visualCharacteristics: Full-width dark ink (#151f27) band with a single centred white 28/36/42 px title; ice variant uses #f4f8fc with ink text.
contentPattern: One row, one cell: a heading (h2), optionally followed by paragraphs, all placed in one centred cell.
usage: Use as a centred section heading band that separates page sections or introduces a following carousel.
reuseGuidance: Reuse wherever a standalone statement heading is needed; use wide right before a carousel and ice on light sections.
